text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent run, Zenno Rob Roy 
stacked up her triumphs. The spectators 
who witnessed her performance—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
While praising it as a great race, the 
crowd buzzed with talk of the Umamusume 
known as the "Great King." Rumor had it 
she had an exceptionally bright future 
ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
However, Zenno Rob Roy's sword pointed 
only toward the future. To draw even more 
eyes, she set her next goal on the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
